Membership Rewards® Program

As a Member, you seamlessly earn Membership Rewards® points on eligible purchases. See your point balance grow, then easily turn those points into vacations, gift cards, meals, household supplies, and more.‡

Membership Rewards® Program - Pay with Points 

For destinations around the globe, Membership Rewards® points can help you get there. Use Pay with Points for flights and prepaid hotels when you book on AmexTravel.com or the Amex Travel App™.‡

Membership Rewards® Program - Transfer Points

Can't get to the beach soon enough? Whether you're dreaming of sunrise abroad or sunset on your favorite shore, American Express offers you the opportunity to transfer points to 20 airline and hotel travel partners. Transfer points to feel the breeze faster.‡

Trip Delay Insurance

Booking the trip is easy. Avoiding delays is next to impossible. If a round-trip is paid for entirely with your Eligible Card and a covered reason delays your trip more than 12 hours, Trip Delay Insurance can help reimburse certain additional expenses purchased on the same Eligible Card, up to $300 per trip, maximum 2 claims per Eligible Card per 12 consecutive month period. Terms, conditions and limitations apply.*‡

*Coverage is provided by New Hampshire Insurance Company, an AIG Company.

Baggage Insurance Plan◆

Travel more comfortably knowing you can be covered for lost, damaged, or stolen Baggage when you purchase the Entire Fare for a Common Carrier Vehicle ticket (e.g. plane, train, ship, or bus) on an Eligible Card. Coverage can be provided for up to $1,250 for carry-on Baggage and up to $500 for checked Baggage, in excess of coverage provided by the Common Carrier. For New York State residents, there is a $10,000 aggregate maximum limit for all Covered Persons per Covered Trip. Please read important exclusions and restrictions.

Car Rental Loss and Damage Insurance◆

Getting into your Rental Vehicle can be the start of a great vacation. When you use your Eligible Card to reserve and pay for the Entire Rental and decline the collision damage waiver (CDW) at the Rental Company counter, you can be covered for Damage to or Theft of a Rental Vehicle in a Covered Territory.

Please read important exclusions and restrictions. Not all vehicle types or rentals are covered. Coverage is not available for vehicles rented in Australia, Italy, and New Zealand. This product provides secondary coverage and does not include liability coverage.

Global Assist® Hotline‡

Whenever you travel more than 100 miles from home, Global Assist® Hotline‡ is available for 24/7 emergency assistance and coordination services, including medical and legal referrals, emergency cash wires, and missing luggage assistance. Card Members are responsible for the costs charged by third-party service providers. Other terms and conditions apply.

No Foreign Transaction Fees

Enjoy every trip abroad with no foreign transaction fees from American Express with the American Express® Gold Card.‡¤

Amex Special Ticket Access and more

Card Members can access Amex Presale Tickets®‡ and Amex Reserved Tickets®‡ to select can't-miss events and moments across sports, music, and more.* Plus, Card Members can enjoy additional perks when attending select events.

*While supplies last, not all seats may be offered.

American Express Venue Collection™

Enjoy an enhanced experience at select stadiums and arenas thanks to on-site benefits including dedicated entrances or fast lanes. Plus enroll your Card and get 10% back on qualifying concessions purchases up to $250 per calendar year. Limit one enrolled Card per Card Member. Learn More.‡

Send & Split®

Send & Split®, enhances the way you send money and split purchases with other Venmo or PayPal users, all in the American Express® App.‡ Now you can pay friends with more flexibility and without the standard Venmo or PayPal credit card fee.‡ You can also seamlessly split your Amex purchases with others and get paid back directly to your Card as a statement credit. Best part? You’ll be the one to earn the rewards for the purchase you split. Enrollment required. Terms apply.‡

Instant Card Number

If your application is approved and you are eligible, you can begin using your Card number online and through your digital wallet, including Apple Pay™, Google Pay™, Samsung Pay, PayPal and Amazon Pay today.‡

Card Member Services

Whenever you need us, we're here.

Our Member Services team will ensure you are taken care of. From lost Card replacement to statement questions, we are available to help 24/7.

American Express® App

Track spending and rewards, find an airport lounge, make a payment, and get important account alerts in real-time with the American Express® App.‡

Additional Cards: Rewards

You can add an Additional Card for anyone 13+ and you will earn Membership Rewards® points for their purchases in the same way you do on your own.‡

Purchase Protection◆

Dropped your phone? Sometimes the unexpected happens. But Purchase Protection◆ can help protect Covered Purchases for up to 90 days from the Covered Purchase date made on your Eligible Card when they're accidentally damaged, stolen, or lost.*
*Up to $10,000 per Covered Purchase, up to $50,000 per calendar year.

Extended Warranty◆

When an American Express® Card Member charges a Covered Purchase with his or her Eligible Card, Extended Warranty◆ can provide up to one extra year added to the Original Manufacturer's Warranty. Applies to warranties of 5 years or less. Coverage is up to the actual amount charged to your Eligible Card for the item up to a maximum of $10,000; not to exceed $50,000 per Card Member account per calendar year. Please read important exclusions and restrictions.

Frequently Asked Questions about the American Express® Gold Card

The annual fee for the American Express® Gold Card is $325¤† for a Basic Card.

  • Additional Cards (up to the first 5) have a $0 annual fee
  • The annual fee for the sixth or more Additional Card is $35 each¤†
When you use the American Express® Gold Card, you can earn:
  • 4X Membership Rewards® points per dollar spent on purchases at restaurants worldwide, on up to $50,000 in purchases per calendar year, then 1X points for the rest of the year.‡ 
  • 4X Membership Rewards® points per dollar spent at US supermarkets, on up to $25,000 in purchases per calendar year, then 1X points for the rest of the year.‡
  • 5X Membership Rewards® points per dollar spent on prepaid hotels booked through AmexTravel.com or the Amex Travel App™. ‡
  • 3X Membership Rewards® points per dollar spent on flights booked through AmexTravel.com or the Amex Travel App™ or purchased directly from airlines.‡ 
  • 2X Membership Rewards® points per dollar spent on prepaid car rentals booked through AmexTravel.com or the Amex Travel App™ and cruises booked and paid through AmexTravel.com.‡ 
  • 1X Membership Rewards® point per dollar spent on all other eligible purchases.‡
The American Express® Gold Card also offers a suite of benefits such as, but not limited to:
  • $120 Uber Cash on Gold: Get $10 in Uber Cash each month when you add your Gold Card to your Uber account. You can use your Uber Cash on orders from your favorite restaurants and rides with Uber in the U.S. when you select an Amex Card for your transaction.‡
  • $84 Dunkin' Credit: With the $84 Dunkin’ Credit, you can earn up to $7 in monthly statement credits after you enroll and pay with the American Express® Gold Card at U.S. Dunkin’ locations.‡ 
  • $120 Dining Credit: Earn up to a total of $10 in statement credits monthly when you pay with the Gold Card at participating partners. This can be an annual savings of up to $120. Enrollment required.‡ 
  • The Hotel Collection: Take advantage of a $100 credit towards eligible charges1 at over 1,300 upscale hotels worldwide every time you book The Hotel Collection through AmexTravel.com or the Amex Travel App™.2‡

    1Eligible charges vary by property.
    2The Hotel Collection requires a two-night minimum stay. 

The American Express® Gold Card has No Preset Spending Limit, a unique feature that gives you the ability to unlock more purchase power as you use your Card. This means the spending limit is flexible. In fact, unlike a traditional credit card with a set limit, the amount you can spend adapts based on factors such as your purchase, payment and credit history.*



*In certain instances, we may assign a specific spending limit to a Card Member's account. This can be due to a variety of factors such as credit score, past due payments with us or other creditors, or high balances on revolving credit accounts. If a Preset Spending Limit is placed on your account, we will notify you, tell you why, and explain how it impacts how much you can spend.

The American Express® Gold Card does not currently have lounge access benefits. For lounge access benefits, explore the Platinum Card® or the Delta SkyMiles® Reserve Amercan Express Card.

Yes, the American Express® Gold Card has a rental car insurance benefit.

Please read important exclusions and restrictions. Not all vehicle types or rentals are covered. Coverage is not available for vehicles rented in Australia, Italy, and New Zealand. This product provides secondary coverage and does not include liability coverage.
